facts.fact: CPJ reports Niger's State Court on 3 December 2025 upheld journalist Samira Sabou's 2020 conviction over a Facebook post, ruling the cybercrime law applied because the offence was by electronic means.
CPJ reports DW Hausa correspondent Gazali Abdou Tasawa was jailed in Niamey on 23 January 2026 after police questioning over his 15 January report on Nigerian refugees.
CPJ reports that five journalists were behind bars in Niger on 1 December 2025 in its annual prison census, over reporting questioning governance.
